goal: Migrate and approve every known non-place page from the legacy VII site to a content-equivalent ASCII URL, enable only verified direct permanent redirects, enforce correct breadcrumbs and prohibit Hebrew slugs in administration.

intent_model.literal_request: Advance everything possible, mirror all old non-place pages and content, create and approve missing search pages, add 301 redirects, report remaining problems per old URL, verify breadcrumbs and non-Hebrew URLs, and prevent Hebrew URL input.
intent_model.implied_outcome: A safe, exhaustive and maintainable SEO migration where no valuable old content is lost and no redirect hides a missing destination.
likely_rejections: Missing legacy pages were redirected to generic destinations
The UI cleaned Hebrew but the API accepted it
Breadcrumbs were checked in only one world

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Build an explicit complete inventory of every known non-place source rather than a representative sample.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Every known source receives a final status and evidence or an exact blocker.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Continue through implementation, verification and public reflection within authorization.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Code or build alone cannot close the task.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: The operator sees one reconciled migration queue with source, destination, readiness and problem.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Approve only content-equivalent destinations that pass readiness.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Publish the ready batch and keep only exact blockers in the remaining list.
deferred_complexity: Place-page migration excluded by the user

natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co and the authenticated VII administration

facts.claim: The approved plan expects approximately 20,000 to 30,000 legacy URLs and forbids unmatched homepage redirects.
The stored current inventory contains 3,526 known legacy sources and 2,313 migrated legacy search pages.

assumptions.claim: The union of legacy sitemap, stored Search Console export and catalog is the largest source currently available.
assumptions.validation: Reconcile source snapshots and report the unavailable complete export as a blocker rather than claiming exhaustiveness beyond it.

out_of_scope: Legacy place pages except preservation regression checks
invariants: Existing place routes and booking behavior remain unchanged
Only lowercase ASCII English slugs are publishable
affected_family: all public worlds and static content templates

requirements.statement: Classify every known legacy non-place URL and preserve its relevant content in the new destination.
Create a direct 301 only when an equivalent final destination passes readiness; otherwise keep a precise blocker or justified 410.
Approved public URLs use lowercase ASCII slugs and Hebrew input is rejected by both UI and server.
requirements.source: User request and account SEO standard

requirements.statement: Visible breadcrumbs, links, canonical URL and BreadcrumbList schema agree across every public world and content family.
requirements.source: User request and VII feedback standard

requirements.statement: The final report identifies each remaining legacy URL and its exact problem.
Production changes are verified on the exact deployed version with rollback preserved.

acceptance_checks.setup: All available legacy sources are loaded.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Every unique known non-place source appears once with source evidence, destination/status, parity state and issue.

acceptance_checks.setup: A destination is missing, redirects again, is unrelated or is the homepage.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Activation is rejected and the source remains listed with a precise reason.

acceptance_checks.action: Request the legacy URL on the deployed version.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: It returns one direct permanent redirect to a 200 self-canonical equivalent page.

acceptance_checks.setup: An editor submits Hebrew, mixed-script, malformed or empty slug text.
acceptance_checks.action: Save through both the UI and direct API validation path.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No page is saved or published and a localized validation error explains the ASCII rule.

acceptance_checks.setup: A valid ASCII slug is saved.
acceptance_checks.action: Reload the editor and open the public route.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The same slug persists and the public route and canonical use it.

acceptance_checks.setup: Representative indexable route from each family and world.
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect visible breadcrumbs, links, canonical and structured data on desktop and mobile.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Labels and destinations match the route hierarchy, links resolve and no approved path contains Hebrew.

acceptance_checks.action: Record candidate and prior deployment identities.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Rollback target is preserved and no unrelated dirty-tree file is included.

open_questions.question: Can the full estimated 20,000 to 30,000 legacy URL corpus be exported from Search Console or server logs?
open_questions.resolution: Complete all currently known sources and report this external source gap explicitly without claiming total historic coverage.

authorization_boundary: The user authorized implementing and approving the requested pages and redirects. Main-domain DNS cutover, unrelated place migration and fabricated replacements remain outside scope.
